title: Better Ground
description:
**Organic Compost** is made from farm waste — rotten flesh, tree bark, straw, spare crops. Leave it beside dirt and it spreads, turning it into **Rich Soil**.

Crops on rich soil grow noticeably faster, and it never needs re-tilling or hydrating the way farmland does.

For a farm selling by the stack, faster growth is the difference between scraping by and running a business.
